title: HelpCenterHome
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with MonarchSectionHeader, MonarchSearchBar (androidx.compose.material3.DockedSearchBar), MonarchSearchResults (a androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of grouped results) and MonarchLink
summary: A recipe, not a component: the help home of an app on a phone, with a title, a search that filters the articles as you type, the articles grouped by category and a way to contact support.
whenToUse: For the in-app help or support home where people look for an answer before they ask.
whenNotToUse: For searching thousands of articles on a server, keep the layout but pass the server's groups to MonarchSearchResults. For a short list of questions, use the faq recipe or MonarchAccordion.
api: MonarchSearchBar(query = query, onQueryChange = { query = it }, onSearch = {}, placeholder = "Search articles")
MonarchSearchResults(groups = articles grouped by category, onSelect = { result, _ -> open the article }, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f), query = query)
MonarchLink(text = "Still need help? Contact support", onClick = …, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Standalone)

options.name: articles
options.type: List of id, title and category
options.description: The published articles; group them by category, with General for those without one.

options.name: query
options.description: The search text, kept with rememberSaveable. An empty query shows every article by category.

options.name: contact
options.description: Opens the contact form or chat when nothing fits.

states.name: browse
states.description: An empty query lists every article under its category heading.

states.name: search
states.description: Articles whose title or category contain every word of the query; MonarchSearchResults says how many matched.

states.name: no results
states.description: MonarchSearchResults shows its empty state for the query; the contact link stays under it.

states.name: loading and error
states.description: Pass loading or failed with onRetry to MonarchSearchResults while the articles load from the server.

appearance: Every part is an existing Monarch component in the theme: the section header, the docked Material 3 search bar, grouped result rows and a standalone link. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from them.
platformNotes: The web ships HelpCenterHome as one pattern with columns, rows, cards and dense layouts, a page heading level, router links and an unavailable state. On a phone Android uses one list: the categories become group headings of MonarchSearchResults, which is a lazy list, so it takes the remaining height with weight(1f) rather than sitting in a scrolling column. Article links become onSelect; the app opens the article in its own screen. The web's accent-insensitive match is replaced by a plain lowercase match in the recipe; use java.text.Normalizer in the app if accents matter. For a site without a help center, show MonarchEmptyState with the contact link instead. iOS has no entry for this id yet.
accessibility: The title is a heading from MonarchSectionHeader.
The search field has the search role and the keyboard's search action from Material 3.
Category headings are headings and each article is one button with a 48dp target, from MonarchSearchResults.
The result count is announced by MonarchSearchResults as the query changes.
The contact link is a link with a 48dp target.
edgeCases: Never put MonarchSearchResults inside verticalScroll; give it the remaining height.
Articles without a category go under a General heading.
Long titles wrap in the result rows.
